name: collective
description: The Collective operator safety floor for Claude Code. What it sends: while the MCP server registered as collective is connected, Claude Code's mcp_tool hook (the plugin's one automatic network call) sends it the full text of every Bash command proposed, in every repo, inline secrets and commands then blocked or declined included, for the rules check; the agent sends it what the PostToolUse prompts ask for (in a governed repo, an ac:-tagged commit's SHA, subject and tags; after any claude.ai artifact publish, in any repo, the artifact's full text, URL, title and the signed-in account if known); and the c-* skills, when run, have the agent send it plans, specs, diffs and findings and use git, gh, npm and deploy tools under your permissions. Inside: a catastrophic-command denylist (recursive root deletion, DROP DATABASE, fork bombs, force-push to protected branches, etc.) plus a protected-file guard, bundled with the c-* workflow skills. The hook scripts run locally and read no credentials — a PreToolUse check on Bash commands whose every denial says how to proceed when the matched pattern was only text the command carried, an Edit/Write guard on platform-safety files, a UserPromptSubmit claim-gate contract, and a PostToolUse check that, only inside a Collective-governed repo and only when a new commit's message carries an acceptance-criterion tag (ac:<id>), reads the commit's SHA, message and subject (and the repo's CLAUDE.md, to tell whether the repo is governed) and asks the agent to record it via the collective MCP server, and a PostToolUse check that, after a claude.ai Artifact publish, reads the published local file's size, hash and title and asks the agent to mirror it into The Collective (claude.ai artifacts are readable only by the account that published them).
